samples.question: Which colored junction is enclosed by the network? Treat every dark link and every uncolored junction as an impassable barrier. A colored junction is enclosed when no blank four-neighbor route from a blank region touching it reaches the canvas edge without crossing a barrier. Exactly one of red, green, and blue is enclosed; answer its color and ignore the canvas border.
